summary: Phase 3 (Read-Side project_cid in sapience-retrieve.sh) is complete. The script now resolves a committed .sapience/project.json binding via the Phase 1 lib/sapience-api-lib.sh resolver and appends project_cid to its /v1/search request, appending nothing on any failure path and benignly degrading (never exit 2) on a 2xx project_rejected reply. Four new test cases plus the unmodified Phase 2 negative control all pass (59/59 assertions), the sibling context-scoping suite passes (6/6), and a grep confirms no write path acquired project_cid. 3 of 5 plan phases are now complete; Phase 4 (document the design in per-repo-scoping.md) and Phase 5 (close the round) remain.
